objective: Wire the GitHub provider into native PM shipping and prove the complete remote lifecycle

acceptance.text: PM remote adapter pushes scoped branches, creates/updates PRs and merges only exact verified heads with passing required checks under standing authorization; fake remote tests cover missing auth, pending/failure, races and merge result mismatch without real remote/model calls.

Actual CLI/API wiring consumes fresh source and integration evidence, reconciles provider merge/squash/rebase lineage and advanced integration tip only with real Git proof, and performs P/E/H closure under standing authority. Unsupported or pending states stay explicit without resetting claims or budgets.

Fake provider and real temporary Git repositories exercise full publish, readiness, exact merge, integration gates, reporting where required, merged Execution and fresh-process handoff; no disconnected helper is presented as an implemented user operation.
